expedition: Seascape Alaska 5: Gulf of Alaska Remotely Operated Vehicle Exploration and Mapping
purpose: Exploration of the walls of this canyon will provide a unique look at the rocks that underlie the shelf, which may form a distinct habitat at sub-shelf depths compared to the post-glacial sediments that are exposed outboard of the shelfbreak. Extensive bycatch of gorgonian coral, black, and hydro corals as well as unidentified and glass sponges has been observed in this area at depths of 300-1200 m. It is thought that corals and sponges are likely to be found in these steeper areas, which are not effectively sampled with
